Tells: Salts-The-Catch, who keeps a house in Lilmoth, asked him for anyone off his ship who saw the camp burn; her guest, a woman called Nesh-Deeka, pays; the house is south of the second big ship, anchored off Lilmoth's own dock, east along the shore past the old lighthouse. Checks: nothing. Does: setStage [quest.main.mq01, 20].

label: Who are you?
intent: Buys-The-Months. Tells: he has said all he will: Salts-The-Catch's house, south of the second big ship, and off his ship. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Who are you?
intent: Salts-The-Catch, inside her door. Tells: she keeps the house and asks nothing of who comes to it; at 20, her guest is in the house. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Buys-The-Months says you pay for anyone off his ship.
intent: Nesh-Deeka, who knows the player's face from what the broker told Salts-The-Catch. Tells: the gang's camp up the estuary burned two nights ago; a woman with a knotted cord at her wrist killed the courier who walked with the gang, who carried a satchel for Nesh-Deeka, and took it; the woman's people cut the camp's Hist cutting, a slip of the sacred tree the families' lives come from, from its eggs, and the eggs died; the gang say the woman looked at the player lying by the fire and let them live; Nesh-Deeka serves the Veiled Reed, the quiet service of the An-Xileel, the state that rules Black Marsh, and the player will say that name to nobody; she has work for a hand nobody can claim, and the player may ask her what they like before they answer. Checks: nothing. Does: setStage [quest.main.mq01, 30].

label: Who was the woman with the knotted cord?
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: she does not know her name; the Reed has word of a cell that cuts a Hist's roots and draws its sap into jars, and the camp is the first of its work she has seen; why it would spare a stranger she cannot say, and would like to know. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: What is the Veiled Reed?
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: the Reed watches for cults, smugglers and killers who would harm the state or the trees; it works through houses like this one, and its people wear no mark. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Why would the Reed want me?
intent: Nesh-Deeka, plainly. Tells: because nobody can claim the player: their name is on no roll; if a hand like that is taken, the Reed never knew them; and the woman who let the player live is the one the Reed is after, so the player has their own reason to look. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: What does the Reed pay?
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: fifty gold in the player's hand when they say yes, and this door stays open to them. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Who does the Reed answer to?
intent: Nesh-Deeka, without softening it. Tells: the An-Xileel's offices at Stormhold, the state's city in the north-west, and nobody else: not a tree, not a village, not a court; none of them sees what the Reed does. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Was the courier who died at the camp one of yours?
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: yes; Mee-Tuja walked with the gang as cover, a hand nobody could claim, as the player would be; now that he is dead the Reed claims neither his body nor his name; that is what being deniable costs, and she will not pretend otherwise. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: What aren't you telling me?
intent: Nesh-Deeka, who is bad at lying to a face and says so. Tells: she is keeping two things from the player, and she will name neither; she says so now rather than have the player find it out later. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: I'll work for the Reed.
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: good; the Reed pays its hands, and she gives the first of it; the Reed's first work: the broker told Salts-The-Catch that one of his gang, Dives-Without-A-Rope, carried aboard a jar the cutters dropped by the fire and will not let it go; bring Nesh-Deeka that jar from the ship's hold. Checks: nothing. Does: setFactionRank [faction.veiled-reed, 0]; giveGold 50; setStage [quest.main.mq01, 90].

label: Not yet.
intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: the offer stands and costs nothing to leave standing; she will be in this house; the broker will not have the player, and the dock has no other work for a stranger, so the player may walk Lilmoth and come back to her. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing (the stage stays at 30).

label: (greeting)
intent: Buys-The-Months, after MQ01. Tells: the player is still on no line of his, and he would rather keep it so. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: I'm looking for work.
intent: Nesh-Deeka, to a player who came without the broker's word. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

intent: Dives-Without-A-Rope, once she has refused, been talked round or paid. Tells: she will work off her months as before; she hopes whoever ends up with the jar finds who cut her tree. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

Does: nothing.

label: Who are you?
intent: Salts-The-Catch, inside her door. Tells: she sells fish and asks nothing of who comes to her house; her guest is at the far end of the room. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

intent: Dives-Without-A-Rope, after MQ03. Tells: she works off her months as before and hopes whoever has the jar finds who cut her tree. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 20.

label: Who are you?

Does: sets stage 30. Fallback when the check fails: he turns back to the roots and says nothing.
fallback: he turns back to the roots and says nothing more to a Lilmoth face

Does: sets stage 30. If the player does not hold the pot: he says the stranger has nothing of his to show.

intent: Turns-The-Clutch, by the egg pool. Tells, ashamed: a boat came in from the north reeds the night the tree shut and went back out, and she took it for a netter; the cut on the root is sealed with black gum made in the village, which Pays-Late keeps in the box at his feet; she will say no more of him. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Who are you?
intent: Turns-The-Clutch. Tells: she keeps the egg pool; the eggs died when the tree shut. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

intent: Pays-Late, after the player gave him the jars and kept his secret. Tells: the sap is back at the root; he keeps his secret and the player's. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: (greeting)
intent: Pays-Late, after he gave his word to tell the root-herald. Tells: the sap is back at the root; he has said what he must say, and he did not cut it. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: (greeting)
intent: Pays-Late, after the player took the jars to Lilmoth. Tells: the tree is still dark and the village still blames him. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: (greeting)
intent: Hires-By-The-Season, after the quest. Tells: the tree is the village's business; the stranger has done what they came to do. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: Who are you?
intent: Hides-His-Wake, at the giant tree, if he is ever made to talk. Tells: nothing; the jars are the Root's and the stranger should go back across the water. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

intent: Counts-The-Jars, at the giant tree, if he is ever made to talk. Tells: he keeps the count of the jars; the stranger has no business here. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: a cut is not a silence, and the interior must hear the difference; the tree-minders and Nisswo of the interior gather at Helstrom, behind the marsh, and carry news home; she wants it said there by someone the Reed can deny, so she sends no escort and the Reed is not to be named; take the coast ship from Lilmoth's stop and go ashore by its door to Helstrom's landing; the way in is root and shallows, and two giant wasps keep it; among the trees by the stone towers west of the paved road, Ei-Tuja, a Nisswo, will hear anyone, and Kaska-Meen is a tree-minder. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 20.

label: How do I get to Helstrom?
intent: Nesh-Deeka, if the player comes back. Tells: the coast ship at Lilmoth's stop, its door to Helstrom's landing, the way in past the wasps, Ei-Tuja and Kaska-Meen among the trees by the stone towers. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: What do you and Kaska-Meen disagree over?
intent: Ei-Tuja, among the trees. Tells: a Hist's silence is its own act, to be read and not clamped; Kaska-Meen holds otherwise; he will hear anyone. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

label: I saw a Hist cut at the root, not gone silent. The village's eggs died of the cut.
intent: Ei-Tuja. Tells: then it is not a silence at all; he will preach it openly in every village he walks to; and what a Hist leaves when it dies: a Mnemic Egg, a seed of its sap holding all its memories, which the Dominion once used to stop a generation of eggs hatching; whoever gathers a living tree's sap may be after such a thing. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 92.

label: The tree-minders should hear this. Will Kaska-Meen?
intent: Ei-Tuja. Checks: nothing. Tells: she hears few strangers, and only one worth hearing; he will not speak for the stranger; let them try her themselves. Does: sets stage 45.

label: What is your place here?
intent: Kaska-Meen, among the trees. Tells: a Hist that falls silent must be watched by tree-minders alone; she does not sit with strangers. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

Tells, if it holds: a cut is done to a tree, a silence is its own; she will carry it to the interior's tree-minders, who will guard their trees and let no stranger near; and what a Hist leaves when it dies: a Mnemic Egg, a seed of its sap holding all its memories, which the Dominion once used to stop a generation of eggs hatching. Does: sets stage 91. If the check fails: she does not sit with strangers; the Nisswo hears anyone.
